description: Enterprise QA Quality Gates and Safety Guardrails for GitHub Copilot Agent

sessionStart.powershell: Write-Host '[QA-Hook: sessionStart] Copilot QA Agent session started. Stack: Java 17+ / Maven / Playwright Java / JUnit 5.'
sessionStart.bash: echo '[QA-Hook: sessionStart] Copilot QA Agent session started. Stack: Java 17+ / Maven / Playwright Java / JUnit 5.'
sessionStart.description: Initialize agent context and verify test runtime

userPromptSubmitted.powershell: Write-Host '[QA-Hook: userPromptSubmitted] Auditing prompt against team guidelines...'
userPromptSubmitted.bash: echo '[QA-Hook: userPromptSubmitted] Auditing prompt against team guidelines...'

preToolUse.powershell: param($tool, $args); if ($args -match 'rm -rf|drop table|git push -f|format') { Write-Output '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked destructive command by QA Safety Gate"}'; exit 1 }
preToolUse.bash: if [[ "$*" =~ rm[[:space:]]+-rf|drop[[:space:]]+table|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+-f ]]; then echo '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked destructive command by QA Safety Gate"}'; exit 1; fi
preToolUse.description: Policy Gate: Block dangerous shell commands or destructive mutations

postToolUse.powershell: Write-Host '[QA-Hook: postToolUse] Tool execution completed. Enforcing QA quality rules...'
postToolUse.bash: echo '[QA-Hook: postToolUse] Tool execution completed. Enforcing QA quality rules...'
postToolUse.description: Trigger automated quality and formatting checks after tool use

sessionEnd.powershell: Write-Host '[QA-Hook: sessionEnd] QA Agent session concluded. Verification artifacts logged.'
sessionEnd.bash: echo '[QA-Hook: sessionEnd] QA Agent session concluded. Verification artifacts logged.'
